
  metrics [flags]
    Show a live telemetry snapshot

    On a terminal the text view is colored and human-scaled; in a pipe it is
    plain and machine-scaled. `--output json` emits the snapshot verbatim for
    scripts, while the text view may change between releases. Works the same
    against an embedded data directory and a remote daemon.

  USAGE
    metrics [--detail] [--queue <name>]... [--watch] [--output text|json]

  FLAGS
    --detail  <bool>    Render the node grid and one card per queue
    --queue   <string>  Focus the text view on a queue; repeatable
    --watch   <bool>    Refresh the view until interrupted
    --output  <string>  json emits the snapshot verbatim (for scripts); the text view may change between releases (default text)

  EXAMPLES
    > metrics
    > metrics --detail
    > metrics --queue events
    > metrics --output json | jq .totals
